verdict.rationale: CockroachDB Cloud's official MCP server lets AI tools authenticate with OAuth or an API key, so the product does issue its own credentials an agent can use. Nothing in the evidence shows those keys can be scoped, role-restricted or limited to read-only or least-privilege access. missing for 10: documented scoping/role-based permissions on API keys, read-only or per-cluster credential restriction for agents, credential rotation/revocation docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Your AI tools can explore live schemas and run queries against any cluster using OAuth or API key authentication.
